The '''Cuthbern system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Wazta sector/Legends|Wazta sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] containing the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Cuthbern]].
